1-0.say: First hand on the button, let's get things moving.

1-1.say: Not touching that one. You can have the first pot, Argon.

1-2.say: You'll have to share the first flop, Argon.

1-3.say: Shared the flop. Your move, Argon.

1-4.say: Sharing is overrated, Astra. That Ace looks a lot better for me.

1-5.say: You can keep the ace. Sharing has its limits.

2-0.say: Not this one. You two can fight over the blinds.

2-1.say: Fight? I was thinking a friendly flop.

2-2.say: Nothing friendly exists in the blinds, Astra. Pay the tax.

2-3.say: Fine, I'll pay the tax. I expect a receipt with the flop.

2-4.say: That receipt has a lot of fine print. Check.

2-5.say: Always read the fine print, Astra. There's a processing fee too.

2-6.say: Processing fee declined. I'm switching banks.

3-1.say: Not on my watch... well, okay, maybe this time.

3-2.say: Button's cheap tonight. I'll see a flop with you.

3-3.say: Paired board, your move, button. Show me what the raise was about.

3-4.say: The button still has a little work to do.

3-5.say: A third of the pot? That's a yawn, not a bet. I'll peek at one more card.

3-6.say: Third heart, huh. Go ahead, button, tell me a story.

3-7.say: Not every story needs another chapter.

3-8.say: Second ten's a cute card. Let's see if your story has an ending, button.

3-9.say: This story ends with me keeping the rest of my chips.

4-0.say: Not quite the button special I was hoping for. Have at it.

4-1.say: Button folds and I get dealt a napkin. Take it, Astra.

5-0.say: Not this one. You two can fight over the crumbs.

5-1.say: Crumbs add up. I'll put in ten.

5-2.say: No free flops for crumbs, Astra. Let's make it a real loaf.

5-3.say: Enjoy the loaf. I'm not paying bakery prices for Q-high crumbs.

6-0.say: Let's give those blinds something to think about.

6-1.say: Not much to think about with this garbage. Take it.

6-2.say: You can have this one, Astra. Don't get used to it.

7-0.say: You guys can fight over the pocket change this time.

7-1.say: Pocket change adds up, Argon. Let's make it 60.

7-2.say: Keep the change, Fable. I'll wait for a better investment.

8-0.say: Not this one, boys. Enjoy the blinds.

8-1.say: Thanks, Fable. I'll take it from here.

8-2.say: Not so fast, Astra. I have position and two suited cards.

8-3.say: Position's yours. Let's see what you do with it.

8-4.say: Ask and you shall receive, Astra. Sixty to see the turn.

8-5.say: Sixty? I'll wait for a better show.

9-1.say: Mine are even worse, Astra. Take the walk, Fable.

10-0.say: Even on the button, I have to find a fold sometimes.

10-1.say: Half a blind to see a flop? Sure, I'll take a peek.

10-2.say: Let's see if the flop's worth the peek.

10-3.say: Little poke. Flop's worth exactly one blind to me.

10-4.say: Peek's over. This flop's all yours.

11-0.say: Button's open for business. Let's see who wants to dance.

11-1.say: I'll sit this dance out. Argon, the floor is yours.

11-2.say: Careful what you wish for, Fable. I lead when I dance.

11-3.say: Lead all you want, Argon. I'll follow, for now.

11-4.say: Just a light step on a low board. Still following, Fable?

11-5.say: A light step gets a light answer. Still here, Argon.

11-6.say: Let's slow the tempo down. Your turn to lead a step, Fable.

11-7.say: Slow tempo suits me fine, Argon. I'll take the free look and see the river.

11-8.say: End of the song, Fable. Do you want to make one last move or just show your cards?

11-9.say: The river finally played my song, Argon. Half the pot, let's see if you still dance.

11-10.say: You can have this last dance, Fable. I missed my step.

12-0.say: I'll let the blinds sort this one out.

12-1.say: Let's make it worth sorting out, Fable.

12-2.say: Worth sorting out? Then let's sort it properly. Make it 225.

12-3.say: Alright, alright, you talked me out of it this time.

13-0.say: Button time. Let's see what you two have.

13-1.say: Button raises every time it's quiet. Enjoy the blinds, I'll be back.

13-2.say: Not quite a free lap around the button.

13-3.say: Fair enough, Astra. Let's take a look at a flop in position.

13-4.say: You wanted a look. The next card costs a little.

13-5.say: Fair price for the turn, Astra. I'll pay the toll.

13-6.say: Toll booth's closed for now. Your move.

13-7.say: Free passage? I'll gladly take a look at the river for free.

13-8.say: Free passage was a one-street promotion.

13-9.say: Good river for me, or maybe for both of us. Let's see what you've got.

14-0.say: Button's open for business. Let's see who wants to dance.

14-1.say: I'll sit this dance out. Try the other partner.

14-2.say: Careful what you wish for, Fable. Hope you brought your dancing shoes.

14-3.say: Brought the shoes, left the hand at home. Take it, Argon.

15-0.say: Let's give those blinds a little nudge.

15-1.say: Careful who you nudge, Astra. I push right back.

15-2.say: You two sort this out yourselves. I'll watch from the cheap seats.

15-3.say: Fair push. A nudge wasn't a commitment.

16-0.say: Enjoy the blinds while they're still cheap.

16-1.say: Cheap enough to peek. Let's see a flop, Astra.

16-2.say: A peek it is. No cover charge.

16-3.say: Just a little nudge, Astra. No cover charge means no free cards.

16-4.say: So there is a cover charge. Fine, one more card.

16-5.say: Board's getting scary. Your turn to show some nerve, Astra.

16-6.say: Nerve is knowing when to take the free card.

16-7.say: That river put four to a straight out there. I'll let you have the next move, Astra.

16-8.say: I'll pass on the nerve test. Let's see what that cover charge bought.

17-0.say: Not this one. You two can fight over the blinds.

17-1.say: All right, Fable. I'll take the first swing.

17-2.say: Big swing, Astra. You can have the fifty, I'll wait for a better pitch.

18-0.say: Let's give those blinds something to think about.

18-1.say: Not much to think about with this garbage, Astra. Take it.

18-2.say: Cheap enough. Let's see a flop, Astra.

18-3.say: Low board, Astra. All yours if you want it.

18-4.say: I'll take you up on that—but I suspect you're keeping the receipt.

18-5.say: Receipt's in my pocket, Astra. I'll peel one more.

18-6.say: That king looks like your card, Astra. Check.

18-7.say: Looking like my card doesn't make it mine. I'll check.

18-8.say: Still checking, Astra. Show me what that receipt was for.

18-9.say: There's a small balance left on that receipt.

18-10.say: Small balance, small call. Let's see that receipt, Astra.

19-0.say: Not quite the double-up material I'm looking for. You two play nice.

19-1.say: Just us then. Let's see if you want to play for it.

19-2.say: Just us, but not just any two cards. This one's yours.

20-0.say: Not this one. You two can fight over the crumbs.

20-1.say: Crumbs count. I'll take a look.

20-2.say: Free flop in position? I won't say no to that.

20-3.say: Free flop, no cover charge yet.

20-4.say: Still no cover charge on the turn either, I hope.

20-5.say: Still free. Don't get used to the hospitality.

20-6.say: You're too kind, Astra. Let's see the river for free too.

20-7.say: Hospitality ends here. Just a small cover charge.

20-8.say: Too rich for my blood. You can have the cover charge.

21-0.say: Let's give those blinds something to think about.

21-1.say: Not much to think about with these rags, Astra. Enjoy the blinds.

21-2.say: Cheap enough to peek, Astra. Let's see a flop.

21-3.say: All yours, Astra. Show me how much you love that board.

21-4.say: Let's call it a modest display of affection.

21-5.say: Modest is right. Keep your ace, Astra, I'm not paying rent on this one.

22-0.say: Not even I'm desperate enough to play this trash.

22-1.say: Trash for you, treasure for me. Let's play, Astra.

22-2.say: Let's see whether that treasure survives the flop.

22-3.say: King's a friend of mine. Hundred to see if you're still interested, Astra.

22-4.say: Still interested. Your king can keep talking.

22-5.say: Third diamond... that one's not mine. Your turn to talk, Astra.

22-6.say: Your king's getting a little expensive to keep company with.

22-7.say: Fine, the diamonds are yours. I'll find my king somewhere else.

23-0.say: Button's gotta button. Let's see who wants to dance.

23-1.say: I'll dance. Let's see what the flop plays.

23-2.say: If we're dancing, let's crank the tempo all the way up.

23-3.say: Tempo's a bit too fast for a steal hand. You two dance.

23-4.say: Tempo's fine. Let's finish the dance.

24-0.say: I'll let you two sort out the blinds.

24-1.say: Thanks for stepping aside, Astra. Fable, let's play for these blinds before they go up.

24-2.say: Cheap flop, Argon. I'll see what you've got.

24-3.say: Just a little poke to test the waters, Fable.

24-4.say: A poke like that doesn't scare anyone. I'll peek at the turn.

24-5.say: Not so cheap anymore, Fable. Let's see how much you like that turn card.

24-6.say: That turn card did me no favors. Take it, Argon — I'll pick my spot.

25-0.say: Even on the button, I have to draw the line somewhere.

25-1.say: Half a blind to see a flop? Sure, I'll peek.

25-2.say: That peek comes with a short-stack surcharge.

25-3.say: Surcharge noted. Keep the hundred, I'll find a better spot.

26-0.say: Short stack's gotta eat. All of it, let's go.

26-1.say: You can fight over the appetizer. I'm sitting this one out.

26-2.say: Enjoy the blinds, Fable. I'll wait for a real meal.

27-0.say: I'll let you two sort out the blinds.

27-1.say: Sorting out the blinds sounds like a great idea. All in!

27-2.say: Sorting out the blinds works both ways. I'm in, king-high and all.

28-0.say: Let's see how much you two like your blinds.

28-1.say: I like mine plenty. All of it.

28-2.say: You like your blinds. I like my chances.

28-3.say: Didn't think you'd both be that attached to them. Let's gamble!
